_comment: SecretGuard repository scan — intentional findings allowlist. Every entry documents WHY the match is not a real secret. Files/patterns NOT listed are scanned and any new finding fails the scan. Values are never recorded here.

files.reason: SecretGuard's own stage-26G test fixtures: AKIA/sk_live_/ghp_ constants are intentionally fake values crafted for the guard's detection tests.

False positive: `const secret = decryptSecret(...)` / `querySecret(...)` reads an encrypted value; no hardcoded secret.
False positive: identifier `handleWebhookWithSecret` / `plaintextSecret` field name; value comes from DB, not a literal.
